title: Area Sales Manager (Santa Catarina State)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Area Sales Manager (Santa Catarina State) em santa catarina. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Ecorobotix SA. creates innovative robotic solutions that reduce the negative ecological impact of modern agriculture. We have developed an AI-based ultra-high precision spot spraying technology that drastically reduces the amount of chemicals used in crop fields while keeping costs competitive. The technology is currently deployed on our tractor towed ARA machine. By joining our talented and dynamic team, you will contribute to a more sustainable, environment-friendly agriculture in an innovative scale-up at the cutting edge of technology. We are a revolutionary organization with a great work environment that supports creativity through self-motivation.   To pursue our growth in Brazil, we are hiring an experienced entrepreneurial mind based in Santa Catarina State for an:    Area Sales Manager     General objective of the role    As an Area Sales Manager of the Ecorobotix SA. Team, you will be responsible for managing and expanding the sales of agricultural machinery within a designated region. The role involves overseeing existing dealer relationships, optimizing dealer performance, and driving new business opportunities by identifying future dealers and customers as well as driving revenue growth. The Area Sales Manager will work closely with dealers to ensure product availability, support, and training, ensuring the company’s agricultural machinery is effectively marketed and sold. This position requires a leader with a deep understanding of market dynamics, strong leadership skills, and the ability to foster a results-oriented sales culture within the region.    Reporting lines and interactions    This role reports directly to the Commercial Director. Internally, you will closely collaborate with other members of the Sales team and other teams of Ecorobotix. Externally, you will interact with dealers, farmers, partners, associations, trade shows, Agronomists, and CCA’s.    A day in the life of an Area Sales Manager    The Area Sales Manager will travel across the designated territory to visit key accounts, meet new prospects, and support dealer partners. Whether you're pulling into a grower's yard or a dealership lot, you're the face of a cutting-edge ag-tech company that's reshaping the future of precision spraying.    You will showcase how our high-precision sprayer delivers real ROI: less chemical waste, more targeted application, and better yields. You walk growers through the technology— highlighting features like variable rate spraying and intelligent targeting—while grounding every conversation in real-world impact. You sit down and dig into the potential customer’s specific challenges and help them see how the product fits into their operation. You're not just selling equipment; you're helping solve problems.   “You’re part field representative, part storyteller, part strategist. You’re a trusted advisor selling value, not just hardware.”    Key Responsibilities    Identify and prospect new customers across Brazil, managing all communication and driving the sales process through to contract signature.   Engage with customers to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions, ensuring strong order generation and relationship development.   Assess customer solvency, share pricing information, negotiate terms, and suggest improvements to optimize pricing strategies.   Provide training and ongoing support to partners, while identifying opportunities for expanding and strengthening the partner network.   Actively participate in industry fairs, customer demos, and events to increase visibility and drive engagement in the region.   Foster collaboration and support within the distributor network to drive sales and enhance product reach.   Create compelling content in collaboration with the marketing team to support campaigns and enhance brand presence.     Qualifications    Master’s degree in Sales and/or Agronomy, or related field.  10+ years of experience in sales and hands-on experience in agriculture, ag-tech, or precision equipment.   Willingness to travel domestically in Brazil.    Must-Have    Experience in Ag-tech or chemical distribution.   Knowledge in Agronomy related to weeding in field crops.     Your Assets    Excellent communication and leadership skills, willingness to build relationships with customers.   Exceptional written and verbal presentation skills, with clear & consistent communication.   High degree of independence, reliability, and spirit of initiative.   Driven individual with systematic, goal-oriented working methods.   Computer skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM tools.   Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills   Team-player

Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.   Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. You know how to direct Claude agent teams to handle parallelizable work — generating component variants, writing test suites, auditing accessibility — so you can stay focused on the decisions that require human judgment. You will balance 90% hands-on codingwith 10% mentorship, and you are expected to set the bar for frontend quality and velocity on the team. Core Technical Domains You will own the user-facing layer across our consumer and clinical platforms: Performant Marketing & E-commerce: Engineering lightning-fast, SEO-optimized storefronts and landing pages. You treat Core Web Vitals as a first-class deliverable. Clinical Web Application (EMR & Provider Portal): Building the " Clinical OS" — complex, state-heavy interfaces where data integrity and reliability are non-negotiable. AI-Powered UI Features: Implementing streaming LLM responses, real-time clinical summaries, and conversational interfaces embedded into patient and provider flows. Virtual Care Interfaces: Implementing Web RTC video components, real-time secure messaging, and low-latency async consultation flows. Design System & Motion: Maintaining a component library using Framer Motion to produce purposeful animations that make the platform feel premium and intuitive.  Key Responsibilities AI-Augmented Frontend Development: Use Cursor, Copilot, and LLMs as first-class tools to generate components, write tests, and iterate on UI logic at high velocity. Prompt quality is part of the craft. Claude Agent Team Orchestration: Coordinate Claude agent teams via the Claude Agent SDK to execute parallelizable frontend work — generating component variants, writing test suites, auditing accessibility, and producing design-to-code translations at scale. You know how to structure agent prompts, verify outputs, and integrate agent-generated code into the production codebase reliably. Aesthetic Engineering: Translate high-fidelity Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive experiences that hold visual integrity across all device sizes and breakpoints. Performance Ownership: Own Core Web Vitals — optimize LCP, INP, and bundle size. Understand hydration, streaming SSR, and caching strategies at a deep level. AI UI Integration: Build and maintain frontend interfaces that consume LLM outputs — streaming text, structured responses, tool-call results — in ways that feel fluid and reliable to end users. State Architecture: Design resilient client-side state capable of handling real-time clinical data, optimistic updates, and complex form flows across the patient journey. Compliance & Security: Ensure all interfaces meet HIPAA/SOC2 standards, with a focus on secure data handling, audit trails, and PII protection.  Required Hard Skills & Tech Stack Next. Js Mastery: Expert-level knowledge of the App Router, Server Components (RSC), and sophisticated caching/streaming strategies. The " Beautiful Web" Stack: Expert proficiency in Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion for fluid, high-end interfaces. Performance Optimization: Proven track record optimizing bundle sizes, hydration cycles, and Lighthouse scores. State Management: Expertise in Tan Stack Query (server state) and Zustand (client state). LLM UI Patterns: Experience building streaming response UIs, chat interfaces, or AI-assisted input flows using Open AI or Anthropic APIs. Claude Agent Teams: Hands-on experience building and directing Claude agent teams using the Claude Agent SDK — from bulk component generation to automated visual regression and test coverage. You can design an agent pipeline, define subagent roles, and validate the output before it lands in production. AI Dev Tooling: Daily active use of Cursor, Git Hub Copilot, or equivalent. Strong opinions on how to use AI for component generation, refactoring, and test writing. Browser Fundamentals: Deep understanding of the DOM, rendering pipeline, and HIPAA-compliant data handling in the browser.  Candidate Qualifications 3+ years of professional frontend engineering experience. AI-Native Workflow: You can demonstrate concretely how AI has accelerated your frontend output. Examples or portfolio required. The Dual-Threat Portfolio: Proven experience building both visually polished, high-traffic marketing sites and complex, data-driven Saa S applications. Uncompromising Eye for Detail: You notice when spacing is off by 2px and care enough to fix it. Typography, micro-interactions, and motion are part of your craft. High Agency: Ability to self-direct, operate in ambiguity, and make high-leverage frontend decisions without constant supervision. Communication: Professional proficiency in English for technical documentation and cross-functional collaboration.  Why Join Lumi Meds? AI as Infrastructure: We don't bolt AI on — it's embedded in how we build. You'll be encouraged and expected to use every tool available to ship faster and better. Design-Forward Culture: We believe healthcare should be beautiful. You'll have the technical freedom to build a premium brand experience without compromise. Direct Impact: Fast, intuitive, and beautiful interfaces directly affect patient outcomes and provider efficiency.

Echosens has made Fibro Scan available in over 127 countries through its network of subsidiaries in Europe (Germany, Spain, UK, Italy), the United States and China (Shanghai, Shenzen and Hong Kong), enabling millions of liver examinations worldwide. Echosens is shaping the future of liver health. As a high-tech company, its connected solutions and services empower medical professionals to manage liver health for simpler, faster and better patient care. In today's digital healthcare environment and the silent epidemic of fatty liver disease (MASLD-MASH), Echosens is pursuing its international expansion and aims to make the liver check-up part of the health routine for at-risk patients, particularly people living with diabetes. Joining Echosens means choosing a rich and rewarding career path within an inclusive and dynamic company in a rapidly changing sector: liver health. To support its strong growth, Echosens is recruiting a: CLINICAL APPLICATION SPECIALIST (M/W) LATAM (ideally Mexico or Brazil) The overall objective is to drive the successful adoption of Echosens technologies across Latin America by supporting healthcare professionals through clinical training, implementation, and ongoing education. This role plays a key part in empowering medical teams to integrate innovative liver health solutions into their clinical practices and deliver better outcomes for patients. Main activities: Support the implementation and clinical adoption of Echosens Fibro Scan technology in healthcare institutions across LATAM Deliver clinical training and education to healthcare professionals and distributor teams Provide clinical and technical support to ensure optimal use of technology Support the sales team with product demonstration, key account training, and clinical expertise  Experience / Education / Special Requirements You have a bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field, and equivalent clinical or technical experience will also be considered. You bring proven experience in implementing and supporting clinical applications within healthcare environments, with a strong understanding of healthcare workflows, processes, and systems. You have excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to deliver effective training and provide user support. Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards, as well as ultrasound expertise, would be an additional asset. Fluent in Spanish, Portuguese and English, you are comfortable communicating across diverse teams and healthcare settings. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and are experienced in coordinating training programs, clinical implementation processes, and other operational methodologies. You are results-driven, proactive, and self-sufficient, able to identify opportunities, gain consensus, and execute solutions efficiently. Your integrity, trustworthiness, and commitment to diversity of thought, combined with strong relationship-building and communication skills, enable you to excel in international healthcare environments. Please submit your application and CV in English. Why join ECHOSENS ? Work on high-impact projects, serving the health of patients around the world. Join a growing, innovative company, where your ideas will be valued and where you can make a difference. Benefit from a collaborative and stimulating work environment, with opportunities for professional development. Contribute to cutting-edge products, within a team passionate about innovation. Adhere to our inclusion, equality and diversity program set up to support our employees in their efforts to be recognized as workers with disabilities.  ECHOSENS is an equal opportunity company in an environment of diversity and does not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, health or disability, or any other status protected by law.

A Brink's é uma empresa líder global em gestão de numerário e valores, soluções digitais para o varejo e serviços gerenciados de ATM. Nossos clientes incluem instituições financeiras, varejistas, órgãos governamentais, casas da moeda, joalherias e outras operações comerciais. Nossa rede de operações em 51 países atende clientes em mais de 100 países. Acreditamos na construção de parcerias que protegem o comércio, e isso exige fomentar uma cultura engajada que valorize pessoas com diferentes origens, ideias e perspectivas. Construímos um senso de pertencimento, para que todos os colaboradores se sintam respeitados, seguros e valorizados, e oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades para participação e crescimento. O Especialista em Vendas de Soluções da DRS é responsável por dar vida às soluções da DRS no processo comercial, atuando na interseção entre produto e vendas. Responsabilidades Trabalhar e apoiar de maneira colaborativa as equipes de vendas e os clientes para posicionar, personalizar e vender o portfólio da DRS; Ter profundo conhecimento do conjunto de soluções e a capacidade de traduzir os recursos do produto em valor para o cliente, atuando como um consultor de confiança ao longo do ciclo de vendas; Garantir que as necessidades do cliente sejam atendidas com as soluções adequadas e permite que as ofertas globais tenham sucesso nos mercados locais; Qualificações Necessárias Aptidão para vendas – Habilidade para interagir com equipes comerciais e clientes, impulsionando a venda de soluções; Liderança – Capacidade de liderar as partes interessadas envolvidas nos ciclos de vendas para a elaboração de propostas comerciais complexas; Mentalidade centrada no cliente – Habilidade para identificar necessidades e traduzi-las em soluções personalizadas; Comunicação – Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita para situações com clientes; Colaboração – Habilidade comprovada para trabalhar em parceria com equipes multifuncionais de produto, vendas e operações; Conhecimento e visão de mercado – Capacidade de sintetizar feedbacks e tendências em insights acionáveis. Habilidades / Ferramentas Críticas Inglês Espanhol Conhecimento em Excel CRM Sales Force.

title: Analista de fp&a sênior
description:
Nova oportunidade para Analista de fp&a sênior em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio. A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras. Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra. Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários. Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais. O futuro do varejo da construção civil tá sendo construído agora — e pode ser com você. Sobre a área de Finanças A área financeira na Juntos Somos Mais desempenha um papel fundamental na sustentabilidade e crescimento dos nossos produtos. Somos responsáveis por gerenciar os recursos financeiros com eficiência, garantindo que todas as operações ocorram de forma estruturada, ágil e em conformidade com as melhores práticas do mercado. Nosso time atua diretamente em três frentes principais: - Faturamento e Prestação de Serviços: Gestão do faturamento, emissão de notas fiscais e apuração de receitas, garantindo conformidade tributária, adequação à reforma e eficiência nos processos. - Contas a Pagar e Gestão de Fornecedores: Administração dos pagamentos da empresa, controle de fluxo de caixa e otimização de processos financeiros. - FP& A: Apoio na análise de dados financeiros e viabilidade de novos projetos, geração de insights para tomada de decisão e otimização de performance. Principais desafios da área: - Automatização e digitalização de processos para maior escalabilidade e eficiência - Integração com outras áreas para fornecer insights estratégicos e apoiar a tomada de decisão - Equilíbrio entre eficiência operacional e governança financeira, garantindo conformidade e agilidade Seu papel: Acompanhar a performance da companhia por meio de análises mensais de resultados, rentabilidade de projetos, ganhos em campanhas e projeções financeiras; Conduzir os processos de fechamento, alocação de custos e apuração de receitas em parceria com o time de Contabilidade; Liderar os ciclos de Planejamento Estratégico, Orçamento (Budget) e Revisões Periódicas (Forecast), garantindo alinhamento entre áreas e visão de longo prazo; Preparar relatórios financeiros completos, incluindo DRE, balanço patrimonial e fluxo de caixa, com visão crítica e foco em direcionar decisões; Desenvolver e acompanhar relatórios gerenciais e de prestação de contas em ferramentas como Excel e Metabase, assegurando consistência e transparência nas entregas; Elaborar materiais executivos para reuniões internas e apresentações ao Conselho, conectando dados financeiros à narrativa estratégica do negócio; Realizar análises financeiras aprofundadas, incluindo custos, margens, despesas e oportunidades de eficiência operacional e redução de custos; Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas, avaliando oportunidades de crescimento e contribuindo com projeções e modelos financeiros robustos; Monitorar tendências de mercado, cenário econômico e mudanças regulatórias — com destaque para os impactos da reforma tributária — e traduzir esses movimentos em orientações práticas para o negócio; Supervisionar egarantir a adequação dos controles financeiros para auditorias internas e externas, assegurando conformidade e governança.  O que esperamos de você: Excel avançado (tabelas dinâmicas, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SOMASE, SE, Modelagem de dados); Conhecimento de ERP (SAP, Oracle, TOTVS); Conhecimento das noções de contabilidade gerencial; Custo por absorção e custo variável; Margem de contribuição, EBITDA, ROIC, CAPEX, OPEX; Noções de estatística e matemática financeira;  Diferencial: Conhecimento em VBA, Power Query, Power Pivot, modelagem relacional DAX); Ferramentas de BI (Metabase, Power BI, Tableau); Familiaridade com auditoria externa; IFRS e princípios contábeis brasileiros; Tributação e impostos (ICMS, ISS, PIS/COFINS);  Se isso tudo faz sentido pra você, o próximo passo é seu. Vem ser Construtor(a) com a gente no maior Ecossistema da Construção Civil! Nosso processo seletivo e o compromisso com a Diversidade: Na #Juntos, valorizamos a jornada de aprendizagem mútua: queremos descobrir, juntos, o potencial de cada pessoa em todas as etapas do processo. Nosso objetivo é criar uma experiência transparente, justa e eficiente, alinhada aos nossos valores e à nossa cultura de protagonismo e impacto. Acreditamos que um time diverso e autêntico é essencial para gerar soluções verdadeiramente inovadoras. Aqui, você será encorajado a ser você mesmo(a), trazendo suas singularidades para somar ao coletivo. Promovemos inclusão de forma concreta, com ações afirmativas que buscam ampliar vozes de diferentes origens e perspectivas. Se você busca um ambiente onde pode ser quem é, aprender com liberdade e contribuir com impacto real, seu lugar pode ser aqui. Vem construir com a gente o maior ecossistema da construção civil! Benefícios de ser um Construtor(a) na #Juntos Por aqui, acreditamos que cuidar das pessoas é tão importante quanto alcançar resultados. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios pensado para apoiar sua saúde, bem-estar, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida — dentro e fora do trabalho. Remuneração variável: reconhecemos resultados de forma justa e transparente. Saúde em primeiro lugar Plano de saúde, odontológico e seguro de vida Zenklub: apoio emocional e saúde mental de forma acessível Wellhub: você escolhe onde e como manter o corpo em movimento  Liberdade e autonomia no seu dia a dia Vale-refeição ou alimentação via Flash (você escolhe como usar) Auxílio Home Office Kit Ergonomia (porque conforto também importa!)  Família em foco Auxílio-creche Licença-maternidade de 180 dias e parental de 20 dias (também para casais homoafetivos ou famílias por adoção/guarda judicial)  Desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo Descontos com parceiros como Conquer, ESPM, MBA USP, EBAC e Com School Programas internos e trilhas de aprendizagem Parceria com o SESC e com a Dr. Pet (20% de desconto nos planos)  Outros benefícios que fazem a diferença Day off de aniversário Posher (para quem está em SP): serviços como massagem, manicure, lavanderia e muito mais com desconto exclusivo

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
Nova oportunidade para Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em araras. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilitiesThe Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline managementMap priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.Eligibility, due diligence & agreementsCoordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentationLead closure of contract signatures.Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).Reforestation delivery enablementTranslate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).Stakeholder engagement and safeguardsPlan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.ReportingLead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.Teamwork and cultureSupport the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributesTo perform successfully in this role, you will have:A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skillsExcellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partnersAbility to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.LocationRemote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructionsEmail CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery ManagerSubmission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager

About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilitiesThe Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline managementMap priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.Eligibility, due diligence & agreementsCoordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentationLead closure of contract signatures.Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).Reforestation delivery enablementTranslate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).Stakeholder engagement and safeguardsPlan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.ReportingLead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.Teamwork and cultureSupport the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributesTo perform successfully in this role, you will have:A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skillsExcellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partnersAbility to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.LocationRemote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructionsEmail CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery ManagerSubmission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: English teacher
description:

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!You be your own boss and set your own scheduleWork from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.C1 or C2 Level English SpeakerUniversity degree in English Teaching or related area.One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.Must pass a criminal background check.Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em campo bom. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilitiesThe Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline managementMap priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.Eligibility, due diligence & agreementsCoordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentationLead closure of contract signatures.Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).Reforestation delivery enablementTranslate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).Stakeholder engagement and safeguardsPlan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.ReportingLead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.Teamwork and cultureSupport the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributesTo perform successfully in this role, you will have:A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skillsExcellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partnersAbility to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.LocationRemote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructionsEmail CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery ManagerSubmission deadline: 30 March 2026
